title: SimplyPrint Job Success Flag Leaderboard
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplyprint:job success_flag=*
| stats sum(success_flag) as total_value, avg(success_flag) as avg_value by printer_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks printer values by total and average success flag across SimplyPrint job events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `success_flag` values for each SimplyPrint job event and review total and average success flag by printer.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total success flag.
grandmaExplanation: It scans which printer shows the biggest success flag numbers in your SimplyPrint job data.
